title: @rethunk/mcp-multi-root-git tool parameter schemas
description: JSON Schema snapshots generated from registered FastMCP tool parameter schemas.

root.description: Repo path, array of paths, or "*" for all MCP roots.

maxChangedFiles.description: Cap changed-file lines per repo (hard cap 20000).

maxSubmodules.description: Cap submodules fanned out to per root (hard cap 256).

root.description: Repo path, array of paths, or "*" for all MCP roots.

presetMerge.description: Merge with preset instead of replacing.

compareRefs.description: Ahead/behind between two local refs (e.g. main vs a feature branch), independent of upstream tracking.

left.description: Base ref (ahead = commits in right not in left).

right.description: Other ref (behind = commits in left not in right).

maxBranchStatusLines.description: Cap raw branchStatus lines per repo (default 500).

root.description: Repo path, array of paths, or "*" for all MCP roots.

maxPairs.description: Max pairs evaluated per root (hard cap 256).

root.description: Repo path, array of paths, or "*" for all MCP roots.
Repo path, array of paths, or "*" for all MCP roots.

since.description: Passed to `--since=`. ISO timestamp or git relative form (`48.hours`, `2.weeks.ago`). Default: `7.days`.

paths.description: Limit to commits touching these paths (max 256, `-- <paths>`).

grep.description: Filter by commit message regex (git `--grep`). Case-insensitive by default — see `ignoreCase`.

ignoreCase.description: Case-sensitivity of `grep` (`-i`). Default true (case-insensitive); set false for case-sensitive matching, aligning with `git_grep`'s case-sensitive-by-default pickaxe.

author.description: Filter by author name or email (`--author=`).

merges.description: `only`: merge commits only (`--merges`). `exclude`: no merge commits (`--no-merges`). Omit to include both.

maxCommits.description: Max commits per root (hard cap 500, default 50).

ref.description: Ref/branch to log from. Default: HEAD.

follow.description: Pass `git log --follow` for rename-aware history. Requires exactly one entry in `paths`.

root.description: Repo path, array of paths, or "*" for all MCP roots.

mode.description: `S` = pickaxe string (`git log -S`); `G` = pickaxe regex (`git log -G`).

term.description: Search term / regex for pickaxe history.

pickaxe.description: Pickaxe history search. Returns `commits[]` (sha + subject) per root.

ref.description: Commit/branch/tag to use as the history tip. Must be a safe ref token.

paths.description: Limit history to these paths (max 256, must resolve within the repo root).

ignoreCase.description: Case-insensitive match (`-i`; affects `G` mode regexes). Default false (case-sensitive) — see `git_log`'s `grep`/`ignoreCase` for the opposite default.

maxMatches.description: Max commits per root (hard cap 1000, default 200).

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

base.description: Base ref (e.g. "main"). Ancestor notation is accepted (e.g. "HEAD~3", "main^2"). Omit for unstaged changes.

head.description: Head ref (e.g. "feature-branch"). Ancestor notation is accepted (e.g. "HEAD~3", "main^2"). Defaults to HEAD. Used only when `base` is set.

staged.description: Show staged changes (`git diff --staged`). Ignored if `base` is set.

findCopies.description: Detect copies from other files (`git diff -C`), alongside default rename detection.

fileFilter.description: Glob pattern to restrict output to matching files, e.g. "*.ts", "src/**".

maxLinesPerFile.description: Max diff lines to include per file. Default: 50.

maxFiles.description: Max files to include in output. Default: 30.

excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns to exclude. Default: lock files, dist, vendor, etc.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

base.description: Base ref (e.g. "main"). Ancestor notation is accepted (e.g. "HEAD~3", "main^2"). Omit for unstaged changes.

head.description: Head ref (e.g. "feature-branch"). Ancestor notation is accepted (e.g. "HEAD~3", "main^2"). Defaults to HEAD. Used only when `base` is set.

paths.description: Scope to one or more files (must be within repo root, max 256).

staged.description: Show staged changes (`git diff --staged`). Ignored if `base` is set.

unified.description: Context lines around each change (`-U<n>`). Default: 3. Use 0 for no context.

findCopies.description: Detect copies from other files (`git diff -C`), alongside default rename detection.

maxBytes.description: Max UTF-8 bytes of diff text to return (default 512000), cut at a line boundary. Oversized output is truncated with truncated:true.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

ref.description: Commit reference (SHA, branch, tag, or ancestor notation like "HEAD~3", "main^2").

paths.description: Optional list of file paths (max 256) to filter the shown diff/stat.

stat.description: When true, show --stat diffstat (files changed summary) instead of the full patch.

maxBytes.description: Max UTF-8 bytes of diff/stat content to return (default 512000), cut at a line boundary. Oversized output is truncated with truncated:true.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

withHunks.description: Parse conflict-marker hunks per file. Set false for just the path list.

maxLinesPerFile.description: Cap on lines scanned per file before marking `truncated: true`.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the file to blame.

ref.description: Optional commit-ish (SHA, branch, tag) to blame at. Ancestor notation is accepted (e.g. "HEAD~3", "main^2").

startLine.description: First line of the range to blame (1-based). Requires endLine.

endLine.description: Last line of the range to blame (1-based, inclusive). Requires startLine.

maxLines.description: Max blamed lines to return. Default: 2000.

ignoreWhitespace.description: Ignore whitespace-only changes when assigning blame (`-w`).

detectMoves.description: Detect lines moved or copied within the same file (`-M`).

detectCopies.description: Detect lines moved or copied from other files in the same commit (`-C`).

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

path.description: File path relative to git root.

lineFrom.description: Start line number (1-indexed). Only hunks overlapping [lineFrom, lineTo] are staged.

files.description: Paths to stage, relative to git root. String or `{ path, lineFrom, lineTo }` for hunk-level staging. Each path is staged individually (`git add` / `git apply --cached` / `git rm --cached`). Deleted tracked files are staged via `git rm --cached`. Cannot combine `lineFrom`/`lineTo` with a deleted file. Rejects `.`, the repo root, and directory pathspecs.

commits.description: Ordered list of commits to create.

push.description: `never` (default): no push. `after`: push current branch to upstream after all commits succeed; fails with `push_no_upstream` if no upstream (commits are NOT rolled back).

dryRun.description: Stage files and return a preview without writing commits; restores the index afterwards. Response is marked DRY RUN.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

remote.description: Remote to push to. Defaults to the remote inferred from the current upstream tracking ref, or `origin` when `setUpstream` is true.

branch.description: Branch to push. Defaults to the currently checked-out branch. Rejected when HEAD is detached.

setUpstream.description: Set the upstream tracking reference (`git push -u`). Use when the branch has not been pushed yet. Remote defaults to `origin`.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

sources.description: Branches to merge into the destination, in order.

into.description: Destination branch. Defaults to the currently checked-out branch.

strategy.description: `auto` (default): cascade fast-forward → rebase → merge-commit per source. `ff-only`: only fast-forward, fail if diverged. `rebase`: rebase source onto destination, then fast-forward (no merge-commit fallback). `merge`: always create a merge commit (no fast-forward). Note: `auto`/`rebase` rewrite the source branch tip in place when rebasing (new SHAs).

message.description: Merge commit message (used only when a merge commit is created).

deleteMergedBranches.description: Delete each source branch locally after clean merge (`git branch -d`). Protected names and remote refs unaffected.

deleteMergedWorktrees.description: Remove local worktrees on source branches after clean merge (`git worktree remove`). Protected source names and path tails skipped.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

sources.description: Sources: SHA, `A..B` range, or branch name (resolves to `into..<branch>`).

into.description: Destination branch. Defaults to the currently checked-out branch.

deleteMergedBranches.description: Delete branch-kind sources locally after success. Protected names and remote refs unaffected.

deleteMergedWorktrees.description: Remove local worktrees on branch-kind sources after success. Protected names and path tails skipped.

strictMergedRefEquality.description: false (default): delete branch when every commit is content-equivalent on destination (patch-id, normal cherry-pick outcome). true: require strict ref ancestry (`git branch -d` semantics — will refuse after cherry-pick due to SHA mismatch).

onConflict.description: `abort` (default): on conflict, run `cherry-pick --abort` and roll back the whole range (unchanged behavior). `pause`: on conflict, leave the conflict and native cherry-pick sequencer state in place — commits already applied stay applied — so it can be resolved and resumed via `git_cherry_pick_continue`.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

action.description: "continue" (default): resolve conflicts, stage them, then resume the sequencer. "abort": roll back to the pre-cherry-pick HEAD.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

ref.description: Commit to reset to: ancestor notation (`HEAD~1`, `HEAD~3`), branch name, or SHA.

force.description: Skip the ancestor check and allow resetting to a ref that is not an ancestor of HEAD.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

sources.description: Commits to revert, applied in order: SHA, branch/tag name, or ancestor notation (`HEAD~1`).

noCommit.description: Pass `--no-commit`: apply the revert(s) to the index/working tree without committing (changes are left staged instead).

mainline.description: Parent number (`-m N`) to diff against — required when reverting a merge commit.

onConflict.description: `abort` (default): on conflict, run `revert --abort` and roll back the whole in-progress revert sequence (unchanged behavior). `pause`: on conflict, leave the conflict and native revert sequencer state in place — commits already made stay applied — so it can be resolved and resumed via `git_revert_continue`.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

action.description: "continue" (default): resolve conflicts, stage them, then resume the sequencer. "abort": roll back to the pre-revert HEAD.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

message.description: If provided, create an annotated tag with this message. If absent, create a lightweight tag.

ref.description: Commit/ref to tag (default: HEAD). Ignored if `delete` is true.

delete.description: If true, delete the named tag instead of creating it.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

name.description: Branch name to create/delete, or the existing branch name for rename.

from.description: Commit-ish to base a new branch on (create only). Default: HEAD.

force.description: Force-delete an unmerged branch (`git branch -D`). Delete only; never overrides protected-branch rejection.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

path.description: Filesystem path for the new worktree (relative paths resolved from git toplevel). Sibling directories outside the repo toplevel are allowed; leading `-` and NUL are rejected.

branch.description: Branch to check out; created from `baseRef` if it doesn't exist.

baseRef.description: Commit-ish to base the new branch on. Default: HEAD.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

path.description: Path of the worktree to remove. Must not be the main worktree. Sibling paths outside the repo toplevel are allowed; leading `-` and NUL are rejected.

force.description: Allow removal of worktrees with uncommitted changes (`--force`).

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

pop.description: Run `git stash pop` instead of `git stash apply` (removes stash after applying).

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

includeUntracked.description: Include untracked files in the stash (`git stash push -u`).

keepIndex.description: Keep staged changes in the index after stashing (`git stash push --keep-index`).

paths.description: Scope the stash to specific paths, relative to git root (must resolve within repo root).
